title: Mixer
text: 在 RF 系统中对混频器建模；按 {Source of conversion gain} 指定转换增益的源参数 Available power；{Available power gain} 指定混频器的线性增益、{Open circuit voltage gain} 指定开路电压增益、{Polynomial coefficients} 指定多项式阶数、{Input impedance (Ohm)} 指定混频器的输入阻抗、{Output impedance (Ohm)} 指定混频器的输出阻抗、{LO impedance (Ohm)} 指定混频器 LO 端口的阻抗、{Noise figure (dB)} 指定混频器的单边带 IEEE 噪声系数、{Ground and hide negative terminals} 指定 RF 电路端子接地、{Nonlinear polynomial type} 指定多项式非线性 Even、{Intercept points convention} 指定截点约定 Output、{IP2} 指定二阶截点 inf、{IP3} 指定三阶截点 inf、{1-dB gain compression power}、{Output saturation power}、{Gain compression at saturation}，按实例取值。

params.name: Source of conversion gain
params.values: 转换增益的源参数 Available power gain (default) | Open circuit voltage gain | Polynomial coefficients

params.name: Available power gain
params.values: 混频器的线性增益 0 dB (default) | scalar

params.name: Open circuit voltage gain
params.values: 开路电压增益 0 dB (default) | scalar

params.name: Input impedance (Ohm)
params.values: 混频器的输入阻抗 50 (default) | scalar

params.name: Output impedance (Ohm)
params.values: 混频器的输出阻抗 50 (default) | scalar

params.name: LO impedance (Ohm)
params.values: 混频器 LO 端口的阻抗 inf (default) | scalar

params.name: Noise figure (dB)
params.values: 混频器的单边带 IEEE 噪声系数 0 dB (default) | scalar

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: RF 电路端子接地 on (default) | off

params.name: Nonlinear polynomial type
params.values: 多项式非线性 Even and odd order (default) | Odd order

params.name: IP2
params.values: 二阶截点 inf dBm (default) | scalar

params.name: IP3
params.values: 三阶截点 inf dBm (default) | scalar

params.name: 1-dB gain compression power
params.values: 1-dB gain compression power inf dBm (default) | scalar

params.name: Output saturation power
params.values: Output saturation power inf dBm (default) | scalar

params.name: Gain compression at saturation
params.values: Gain compression at saturation inf dBm (default) | scalar
